newsitem.headline: E&S Holdings sets $200 mln notes, yield 10.375 pct. [CORRECTED 22:35 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects yield in headline and table to 10.375 pct from 11.50 pct)
The following 144A private placement debt issue was priced late Tuesday, according to a high-yield market source.
Merrill Lynch & Co and NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc are co-lead managers on the deal.
